prompt: A minterm must select only the input row A high, B high, C low. How should its inputs be combined?

options.text: Invert A and B, keep C, then AND all three
OR A, B and inverted C
options.explanation: An OR is high for many rows; a minterm must select exactly one.

options.text: AND A and B and ignore C
AND A, B and inverted C
options.explanation: Correct. Every part is high exactly on the required row.

workedExample: A minterm checks every input. Required high bits enter unchanged and required low bits enter inverted. AND requires all three checks to pass, so any one-bit mismatch turns the output low.
